parole.significato: A Sardinian dessert made from candied orange peel in honey and toasted almonds.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sardinian, from Arabic نَارَنْج (nāranj), from Classical Persian نارنگ (nārang, “orange”), from Sanskrit नारङ्ग (nāraṅga, “orange tree”), from Dravidian. Doublet of orange.
